title: THE BOYZ's Ju Haknyeon Denies Involvement In Prostitution In Handwritten Letter
text:
THE BOYZ’s Ju Haknyeon Denies Involvement In Prostitution In Handwritten Letter
Ju Haknyeon's contract with THE BOYZ was recently terminated in the wake of rumours over his meeting with a former adult star.
Ju Haknyeon, a member of the K-pop boy band THE BOYZ, has become the center of controversy following reports of a private meeting with a former adult film star. According to sources, the idol was seen meeting Asuka Kirara, a retired Japanese AV (adult video) actress, at a private bar in Tokyo during a late-night gathering on May 29.
In the wake of the incident, Ju Haknyeon has been officially removed from THE BOYZ. His contract with One Hundred Label, a subsidiary of IST Entertainment, has also been terminated. The decision has shocked fans and sparked intense discussion online, as the agency and group move forward without one of their original members.
Recommended Stories
The agency also issued a statement to confirm Ju Haknyeon’s exit. In response to the controversy stemming from reports of his engagement in prostitution, the idol has posted a handwritten letter denying the claims of his involvement in any illegal activity.
As translated by Soompi, Ju Haknyeon began his letter with a sincere apology to fans and others who were shocked or concerned by the recent controversy. Addressing the reports directly, he admitted to attending a private gathering involving alcohol in late May, accompanied by an acquaintance. While he did not deny the meeting, he expressed regret over his actions and acknowledged the disappointment caused by the situation. “It is completely false that I engaged in any illegal activity, such as the prostitution that is being mentioned in news reports and rumors. I am deeply reflecting on my actions, and I would like to sincerely apologise to everyone who was shocked by this," he added.
View this post on Instagram
Prior to this, THE BOYZ’s agency, One Hundred, announced Ju Haknyeon’s exit from the group and company over “issues" in his personal life that have made it difficult for the company to “maintain trust in him as an artist."
“We recently took action to suspend Ju Haknyeon’s activities as soon as we were informed that he was involved in a controversial incident in order to take time to thoroughly investigate and verify the facts. As a result of our investigation, we have recognised the severity of the issue and have taken it seriously," the agency added as per Koreaboo. It also shared that the decision was taken after a lot of consideration and discussions with the other members of the group.
Although the label refrained from elaborating on the issue, news reports suggested that Ju Haknyeon was spotted drinking with the former adult star, with witnesses describing moments of closeness between them. In the meantime, the controversy has sparked sharp reactions from fans, with many raising questions over the idol’s conduct.
